_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee Tic Tac Toe. Hadafkaagu waa inaad ku guuleysato seddex isku xigta (xajmiga, toosan, ama iskutallaab) guddiga. Marka aad soo jeediso, waa inaad doorataa lambarka laba jibbaaran (0-8) ee aad rabto inaad calaamaddaada geliso marka xigta. Tusaale ahaan, '[4]' waxay calaamaddaada gelisaa unugga dhexe ee guddiga. Sida ciyaaryahanka {player_id}, waxaad noqon doontaa '{symbol}', halka qofka kaa soo horjeeda uu yahay '{opponent_symbol}').

board.current_board: Guddiga hadda jira: {board} Dhaqdhaqaaqyada la heli karo: {moves}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wareejinta la soo gudbiyay ma raacayso qaabka saxda ah.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ma ahan unug sax ah. waa inuu u dhexeeyaa 0 ilaa 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Qolka {cell} waa mid horay loo qabsaday.

game_action.placed: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuxuu calaamadiisa ({symbol}) ku dhigay unugga {cell}.
